        int mod = scanner.nextInt();

    public static void solve(int n, int mod) {
        java.util.List<long[]> inversions = new java.util.ArrayList<>();
        inversions.add(new long[]{1});
        for (int i = 1; i < n; i++) {
            long[] last = inversions.get(i - 1);

            for (int j = 0; j < next.length; j++) {

                    }

                next[j] = e;
            }
            inversions.add(next);
        }

        long[] perms = new long[n];
        perms[0] = 0;
        for (int i = 1; i < n; i++) {
            long c = (perms[i - 1] * (i + 1)) % mod;
            long[] inv = inversions.get(i - 1);
            for (int j = 0; j < inv.length; j++) {

                }
            }
            perms[i] = c;
        }
        System.out.println(perms[n - 1]);
